_strategyNote: Bound action; post empty body, expect 200 with { Endpoint: <url> }. Field is PascalCase (discovered 2026-04-17). Eval pipeline uses this to acquire the Direct Line token URL for a bot.
lastVerifiedBy: Live on bot 6d143a89... via diagnose-direct-line.js; returned HTTP 200 with Endpoint=<string len=197>
knownQuirks: Response field is 'Endpoint' (PascalCase) — NOT 'endpointUrl' or 'endpoint'. Legacy parsers looking for other casing will silently fail.
Response includes @odata.context metadata (~116 chars). Not relevant to contract.
The returned Endpoint URL is a signed pre-authenticated URL — GET against it (no Authorization header) returns { token, conversationId, expires_in }.
For bots without Direct Line enabled, the bound action still returns 200 but the Endpoint may be absent or empty — verify before use.

errorCases.reason: Bot not eligible for Direct Line
